question: After November 11, 2026, does Jules still accept new tasks or new sign-ups, and does the free plan page still list the free plan? Re-capture jules.google, /docs/usage-limits/ and /docs/changelog/ on or after November 12, 2026; if no new work can start, propose dead with cause dead-service.
why: The notice sets the end of sessions at November 11, 2026 and the wind-down at December 31, 2026; on November 3, 2026 the free plan is still advertised and the service is live, so the record is not yet dead. Whether a new account can start the free plan cannot be seen without a sign-up (unverified: behind a sign-up).
